# Tripplefour

> South Africa's online store for CBD infused products — edibles, vapes, dab concentrates and accessories. Fast nationwide delivery from R50.

Tripplefour ships CBD infused products across South Africa with same-day dispatch and delivery to Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria and nationwide. Orders are 21+ only. Payment by EFT or PayFast.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, featured drops, FAQ.
- [Shop](/shop): Full product catalog — edibles, vapes, dab, accessories.
- [Blog](/blog): CBD news, guides and tips for South Africa.
- [Partners](/partners): Sponsorship tiers and brand partnerships.
- [Affiliate](/affiliate): Earn R58.50 commission per vape sold.
